text:
After the Battle of Odessen, Senya Tirall flees with her severely injured son, Arcann, the deposed Emperor of Zakuul. Arriving at Ord Mantell seeking refuge, Senya tries to meet with a cell of renegade Knights of Zakuul that refuse to pledge fealty to the new Empress Vaylin.

Upon arrival, Senya finds that the renegade Knights have been recently killed, with Vaylin lying in wait for her. The two engage in a fierce duel, although when a lightsaber pike thrown by Vaylin critically damages the hyperdrive of a crashed shuttle near their duel, it causes a massive explosion. In the explosion, Senya and Vaylin are separated from each other, and Senya takes the opportunity to flee and seek help elsewhere.
title: A Mother's Hope

text:
On a wide-open plain on the moon of Concordia, Galron is finishing a day of training with his young twin daughters, Tayn and Mari. He is raising them to be Mandalorian warriors, just like him and their mother. They have built a big fire to scare away predators and are getting ready to sleep. Mari demands a bedtime story from her father. After pretending to protest that they are getting too old for stories, Galron asks if they want to hear about the great warrior Shae Vizla.

It turns out that the girls have already heard most of what there is to know about Shae. They know that her brother was killed by the Jedi, and that after that she harbored a grudge against them and preferred to fight alone. They know of her heroics during the destruction of the Jedi Temple. Galron explains that she did not destroy the temple herself, but she singlehandedly breached its defenses and opened it for attack. Tayn and Mari only want to know why Shae has not fought any battles recently, especially with a new war raging everywhere. Their father answers that she and her clan have not been seen in years. He guesses that she is only waiting for the next challenge big enough for her.

Since the girls already know so much about Shae Vizla, Galron instead entertains them with a story of Mandalore the Conqueror, even though he is fairly sure they heard it already and are only humoring him. Tayn falls asleep before he finishes, but Mari lies awake. She asks to borrow her father's helmet so that she can practice sleeping in it like a warrior. He lets her have it. Mari then, a little nervously, asks her father if he is looking for a big challenge like Shae Vizla. He assures her that she and her sister are big enough challenges for him. As Mari drifts off, Galron decides to sacrifice sleep to carve his daughters new wooden practice swords before the morning.
title: Bedtime on Concordia

text:
Rass Ordo meets his older brother Jekiah, or Jek, at a table in Cover Fire, a cantina on Geonosis that caters to Mandalorians. Jekiah has recently been named Arbiter by the reigning Mandalore, Shae Vizla. Rass notices immediately that his brother feels the burden of his responsibility, and Jek begins to tell him about an escalating blood feud between Clan Nerak and Clan Shale. Nerak's new leader is a hotheaded young warrior named Ballag who gained the position after killing his predecessor. Now he has been picking fights with outsiders in an effort to look strong. He has brutally murdered a membrer of Clan Shale. As Arbiter, Jekiah has to intervene to prevent the feud from threatening the unity of the Mandalorian clans.

Rass is present at Jekiah's formal audience with Ballag and the Shale leader, Arla. Jek knows Arla from when they fought together in the Raid on Darvannis. He rules that the two leaders must either drop their dispute or settle it in a duel. Both accept, but Jek adds that the entire clan of the loser will be killed. Ballag is outraged, but Arla accepts immediately. Ballag then has little choice but to accept as well. Rass tries to convince his brother to reconsider: such a measure has not been seen in Mandalorian justice for a generation. But Jekiah refuses to discuss his decision.

The duel draws a large and restive crowd. Jekiah's extreme ruling has caused a scandal among the clans. Jek signals the start of the duel. Ballag launches a series of flashy, aggressive attacks on the older woman, using his jetpack add force to his blows with a serrated knife and a spiked buckler. Arla conserves her energy and stays in a defensive stance, but she takes more wounds than her opponent. After she parries one of his attacks, he quickly turns and strikes her neck with the buckler, a seemingly crippling wound. But as he goes in for a killing blow, Arla suddenly swings her rifle and plunges its bayonet into his chest. Her wounds are not as serious as she was pretending. Arla holds Ballag's own knife to his throat. But instead of killing him, she asks the Arbiter to declare the duel a draw. Jekiah immediately  grants her request.

Later, Rass meets Jekiah again outside the same crowded cantina. Rass expresses his amazement that his brother would take the risk that he did. Jek replies that he knows and trusts Arla; he was confident that she would win the duel but spare Ballag, hurting his position in his clan. And indeed, Clan Nerak has already deposed him and chosen a new leader. Jek does not want to go into their usual cantina and insists that they eat at another place tonight. The two brothers walk away in silence.
title: Seeing Red

text:
Jace Malcom debates with a fellow soldier about whether the Sith will send vultures to pick off their wounded soldiers on Kalandis 7. After a short conversation, they decide to leave their fellow soldier behind. They proceed to navigate a series of canyons, where the fog is thick and their communications equipment receives a propaganda report about the Empire's withdrawal from Corellia.

They make it through the canyon and onto a cracked plain, where they drop a beacon so their fighters can target a spaceport with explosives. They take down two Imperial soldiers with blaster bolts before proceeding to plant the beacon, then decide to go after an enemy ship in order to find the locations of other Imperial targets on Kalandis 7.
title: The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom

text:
Hylo Visz is a freelance smuggler doing a job for Barrga the Hutt in Corellia with her ship, Crimson Fleece, accompanied by Barrga the Hutt enforcers', Musk and his Weequay partner.

After landing in Rendili Corporate facility, Hylo Visz senses a trap, but before she can depart with the ship, she is trapped by Musk and his partner, who don't believe in her and try to finish the deal instead.

After being trapped in the cargo hatch, Hylo Visz escapes to the landing pad and sees her ship blown up after finishing the deal and taking off with the two enforcers on board, due to Rendili Vehicle Corporation trying to double-cross Barrga the Hutt.

Attempting to escape, Hylo Visz moves through the Rendili Corporate facility, without being discovered until she finds a ship; a new Defender-class light corvette doing its first flight test. Visz is able to steal the ship from the pilot, who is a Jedi and escapes from the planet.
title: The Old Republic: Smuggler's Vanguard

text: Nira and Veesh, two Umbaran commandos, escort a shipment of Adegan crystals onboard a hover train traveling across the dangerous countryside between Umbaran cities. To pass the time during the trip, they tell stories of past trips and battles they have experienced during previous escort missions; to the horror of the rookie commando onboard, who is performing escort duty for the first time. Without warning, the train is attacked by Republic raiders intent on claiming the Adegan crystals for themselves.
title: Trading Scars
